claims.text: Named Entity Recognition (NER) is a task in Natural Language Processing that involves identifying and classifying entities such as proteins, genes, diseases, treatments, and drugs in text.
In the biomedical domain, NER systems extract medical problems, tests, and treatments from clinical documents like discharge summaries and progress notes.
NER in the biomedical field faces unique challenges compared to general text due to the complexity and specificity of the language used.
